caption: Performance of different tuning methods on GLUE for RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large. Here we also include two random baselines: (i) S_0-model, where all the designs are randomly selected for RoBERTa. (ii) S_3-model, where we randomly assign strategies to different RoBERTa layers while following the other design choices we learn from T5 models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance of various fine-tuning methods for RoBERTa-base and RoBERTa-large models. The horizontal axis contains the fine-tuning methods, which are listed in the order: Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, $S_1$-model, $S_4$-model, and $S_5$-model, with no specific scale or order indicated. The vertical axis represents the GLUE performance, labeled as "GLUE Performance," with a scale ranging from 85 to 88, but with no units provided; the tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1. Each fine-tuning method is represented by two bars, one in blue for the base model and one in orange for the large model, with approximate values as follows: Prefix (85, 86), Adaptor (85, 87), LoRA (87, 88), BitFit (85, 87), $S_1$-model (86, 86), $S_4$-model (87, 87), and $S_5$-model (87, 88). The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color-coded representation of model size.
